headline: Small, clean longer-period ESE — waist-high fun for the log crowd.
today: About 1.5ft at a respectable 8.5s from a good ESE angle, so it's got some shape despite the size. Cross-off in the morning goes light by afternoon, so the wind isn't a problem — it's just small. Bring the log and enjoy an easy summer session.

daysToWatch.note: Swell jumps to head-high-plus on a prime SSE angle, but 23-25mph S onshore hammers it all morning and afternoon. Wind backs off to 5mph NE cross-off in the evening — that's your only clean window, and it could be worth it.
Chest-high shortish-period ESE with N offshore dawn into NE cross-off morning. Clean and surfable early — shortboard or fish.
SSW cross-on 15-19mph all day. Junk, skip it.
Building S swell to 3.6ft with light and offshore-ish winds. Worth watching for a clean shortboard day.
